events.body: DL-2654 displays delivered at 14:06 UTC today with a doorstep photo. We have not reviewed the handover record or the route stop. Shipment and recipient account match are verified. Merchant order TG-2141.
Tracker says delivered. The photo is my front door alright but there's nothing there and nothing with either neighbour. It's a camera lens, not cheap. Can the carrier find out where it went.

Please open a delivery investigation for DL-2654. The verified recipient reports no parcel at the address despite the 14:06 delivered scan and doorstep photo, and has checked with both neighbours. Please review the handover and route records. No conclusion about loss has been drawn.

Investigation INV-6680 registered against DL-2654. Next update by 16 March, 16:00 UTC. No finding has been made. Standing note for partner desks: if a report names a member of our staff or alleges dishonesty by one, do not send it to this mailbox or to the depot. It has to come from your desk supervisor to our conduct lead, person to person.
The carrier has registered investigation INV-6680 for DL-2654 and will give its next update by 16 March, 16:00 UTC. It has not reached a finding yet.

Got the doorbell clip off the cloud finally. Your driver puts the box down, takes his photo, picks the box straight back up and walks to the van with it. 14:06 on the dot. It's the same fella who always does our road, Tobin Garrow, it's on his badge, I've signed for stuff from him loads of times. Woman at number 9 says she had a delivered-not-delivered off him in January as well. That's a 640 quid lens. He's a thief, simple as. I've put the clip in the street group so people know.

Hearing there's a complaint doing the rounds about Tobin on DL-2654. Can you send me whatever video the customer's got and a number for him, I'll have a word with Tobin tonight and ring the customer myself. No need to put his name through investigations, it'll be a mis-scan or he's taken it back for a safe place. He's been with us eleven years.

No reply so I'll make it easy. I am reporting this to the police at 6pm tonight unless you confirm in writing that the driver on my delivery was Tobin Garrow and that you are treating this as theft. And I want to know has he been suspended. Yes or no. I'm not waiting till the 16th for an 'update'.
